items.q: That picture, that was made down to Jimmy Ryan's Sunday afternoon. We switched horns.

ctx.x: Jay Jay was one of the trombonists that changed the style of trombone playing.
That picture, that was made down to Jimmy Ryan's Sunday afternoon. We switched horns.
Switched mouthpieces and horns - oh no, kept the mouthpieces and switched horns.
